description: Short incident reports written for this project (fictional places and events) with reference transcripts. Used for protocol SP2: synthesised with Kokoro-82M, transcribed with faster-whisper, compared with these references. Not real reports; not CrisisMMD content.
author: voice-vision-incident-reporter project

reports.text: There is a fire in the warehouse on Harbor Road. Thick black smoke is spreading toward the houses. I think two workers are still inside.
The river flooded Mill Street about twenty minutes ago. The water is rising fast and three cars are stuck. Nobody is hurt so far.
A building collapsed on King Street at seven fifteen this morning. People are trapped under the rubble. Firefighters just arrived.
Power lines are down across Oak Avenue after the storm. The road is blocked by a fallen tree and the power is out on the whole block.
Two cars crashed at the junction of Pine Road and Lake Street. One driver is bleeding from the head. An ambulance is on the way.
About forty families have been evacuated from the flooded area near the school. They need blankets, food and bottled water at the shelter.
The wildfire is moving down the hill toward Cedar Lane. We can see flames from the park. Please send more crews.
Volunteers are handing out donations at the community center on Main Street. They have enough food but need more blankets.
The roof of the sports hall caved in after the heavy snow. The hall was empty, so no one is injured, but the entrance is blocked.
Water is coming up through the drains on Bridge Street. The ground floor of the pharmacy is underwater and the owner is stranded upstairs.
A gas leak was reported outside the bakery on Station Road at nine pm. Police have closed the street and residents are leaving.
After the earthquake the wall of the old hotel came down onto the parking lot. Several vehicles are damaged. I do not see any injured people.
Smoke is coming out of the second floor window of the apartment block on Elm Street. The fire department is already here.
The bus overturned on the highway near exit twelve. There are around fifteen passengers. Some are hurt and paramedics are treating them.
The storm tore the roof off a house on Birch Drive. The family is safe with neighbors but the house is destroyed.
The flood water has reached the hospital parking garage on Market Street. Staff are moving patients to the upper floors.
A landslide covered the road to the village this afternoon. Debris is blocking both lanes and about a hundred people are cut off.
Rescue teams pulled a man out of the collapsed garage on Maple Street. He is conscious and is being taken to the hospital.
There are downed trees and debris all along Riverside Park. No one is hurt but the paths are dangerous.
A transformer exploded behind the shopping mall and started a small fire. Firefighters put it out within ten minutes.
Hundreds of people are waiting at the stadium shelter. They have been displaced by the flooding and need drinking water.
The bridge on Canal Street is cracked after the tremor. Police stopped all traffic at eight thirty.
A tree fell on a parked car on Walnut Street. The car is crushed. Nobody was inside.
Just a quick update, the weather service issued a storm warning for tonight. Nothing has happened yet in our area.
